facts.fact: With nothing in the Environment Texture's Vector input, the middle column of an equirectangular image (u = 0.5) lights the scene from +x (azimuth 0); Texture Coordinate Generated -> Mapping at rotation 0 gives the same

A Mapping node of type POINT (the default) rotated +90 degrees about Z turns the lighting by -90 degrees (clockwise seen from above): the light that came from +x comes from -y. Type TEXTURE turns it the other way, by the rotation as written. The amount matches the angle in both
